display_name: Read a bound snapshot or verified historical lane packet
description: Required agent_instance_id, unit_id, repository_id and assignment_sha256 must match the verified stored managed-session assignment. The target root and lane name come exclusively from that row, never a caller path or ambient root. Calls require the exact current binding of the spawning coordinator role, reusing the managed-dispatch coordinator succession authorizer; no role or call-context privilege is granted. Optional packet_id selects one explicit historical immutable packet and re-verifies its complete integrity/binding. Without packet_id the call only snapshots the current bound lane and returns fingerprint, completeness and bounded inventory: snapshot_only=true and custody_verified=false. A snapshot provides expected_fingerprint for preserve_lane_evidence, never custody or deletion proof. Optional payload_path plus payload_layer (index or worktree) requires packet_id and selects only one stored payload; no arbitrary source/destination or dump-all access. The response base64-encodes at most 65536 bytes; a larger selected payload stays in verified storage and returns its length plus a named omission advisory, without its bytes. Omitting packet/payload selection clears that request only. Original and successor packets remain readable independently; corrections are new captures, history is immutable and retained indefinitely without delete/prune/expire/reopen. Unsupported/protected original payload remains untouched with named incomplete-custody diagnostics. No host termination or removal occurs. For retirement, this immutable packet may be selected only by a separately authorized retire_session request that supplies packet_id and the same expected_fingerprint; retirement re-verifies the whole packet and a fresh complete bound lane inventory before host action and again before removal. A single retire_session request may instead specify preserve_evidence=true with expected_fingerprint, disposition, rationale and optional predecessor_packet_id; that request captures and verifies the packet before proceeding. These request fields describe the retirement workflow and grant no host or removal authority to this process. A manually copied directory or its hashes are not native packet custody. While the original managed lane exists, capture that original through native preserve and keep any external Controller copy intact. This does not import an external root or recover bytes after the original is absent. Packet recovery proves bytes only, not landing, host death or deletion authority.
embedding_description: Read a bound lane snapshot or immutable packet with read_lane_evidence; capture bytes using preserve_lane_evidence. An authorized retire_session request may select a packet by id after fresh fingerprint verification. Manual copies and hashes are not native custody; capture the still-extant original and retain external copies. Readback grants no host termination or removal authority.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Read a bound snapshot or verified historical lane packet
result_processor_customizations.result_description: code, snapshot_only, custody_verified, deletion_authority=false, fingerprint, complete, bounded summary, incomplete_count, at most 20 named incomplete entries and advisories; verified reads also include packet_id, binding, provenance and payload_bytes. Explicit selected-payload responses include selected_payload_bytes and payload_base64 when bounded. Missing ancillary metadata is advisory; inaccessible, corrupt or wrong-bound packet bytes cannot yield custody_verified=true. Audit observations and their correction/withdrawal are never custody proof.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Distinguish snapshot-only inventory from verified immutable custody. Show named integrity failures and advisories, preserve immutable packet ids, and never claim termination, removal, landing or deletion authority.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Authorization and identity/path-integrity violations refuse. Ancillary audit unavailability is an advisory on successful local custody. Unsupported index/protected leaf state remains in place and cannot yield a complete packet.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use the stored managed identity and current coordinator binding. Read a fresh bound snapshot before capture and pass its complete fingerprint as expected_fingerprint. For retirement, use retire_session with either an existing packet_id plus expected_fingerprint, or preserve_evidence=true plus expected_fingerprint, disposition and rationale; the retirement verb re-verifies custody before host action and removal. If the original lane still exists, capture that lane through native preserve and keep external copies untouched. A manual directory or hash is not a native custody packet. Preserve protected or unsupported state in place; never delete it to make custody pass.
